---
**PIXEL STUDIO — PRODUCT REQUIREMENTS DOCUMENT**
**Annual Financial Statement: Self-Service View & Download**
---

## 1. STRATEGIC CONTEXT

PIXEL is in growth phase where reducing friction builds trust faster than sophisticated features. Self-employed users and salaried professionals filing advance tax need quarterly and annual statements today—currently forcing 500-800 support tickets monthly and 30-minute wait times via phone. Delaying this 2 quarters risks positioning PIXEL as a "lifestyle card" rather than a serious financial instrument, ceding ground to traditional banks in the tax-filing season (March-July) when statement requests peak.

---

## 2. PROBLEM STATEMENT

Users filing income tax returns or advance tax cannot access annual or quarterly financial statements for their PIXEL credit card beyond the last 6 months of monthly statements. They must call customer care and wait up to 30 minutes for email delivery, creating friction during tax season. This generates 500-800+ avoidable support tickets monthly and positions PIXEL as less capable than legacy HDFC Bank credit cards which provide this as standard.

---

## 3. CURRENT STATE

**User Journey Today:**
- User needs annual statement (FY 2023-24) for ITR filing
- Logs into PIXEL app → Statements section → Can only download last 6 monthly statements
- Calls customer care → Requests annual statement → Waits on hold
- Agent manually triggers statement generation → User receives password-protected PDF via email within 30 minutes
- Statement includes all billed transactions for requested period

**Manual Processes:**
- Customer care agent manually initiates statement generation request
- Backend system compiles transactions, rewards, EMI details, add-on card activity
- PDF generated and emailed to registered email ID
- No in-app visibility or self-service option

**Business Consequence:**
- High support volume during tax season (March-July)
- Poor user experience compared to legacy HDFC Bank cards
- No data on statement usage patterns (requests routed through voice channel only)

---

## 4. COMPETITIVE CONTEXT & DIFFERENTIATION

### Whitespace Signal
**First-mover opportunity:** No digital-first competitor (OneCard, Scapia, Slice) has publicly emphasized comprehensive annual financial year statements specifically designed for CA-assisted tax filing with transaction summaries, rewards, EMI, and add-on card details in a single consolidated view.

### PIXEL's Chosen Angle: **Zero-Friction Instant Access**

**Why This Angle:**
- Leverages existing HDFC Bank statement generation infrastructure (no new partnerships or ML models required)
- Addresses real user pain during high-stakes moment (tax filing)
- Differentiates PIXEL from neo-banks while matching legacy bank capabilities
- Enables faster time-to-market than "intelligent tax assistant" or "CA marketplace" approaches
- Pre-generated statements reduce support load without requiring user education

**Why Now:**
- Tax season (March-July) drives 60%+ of annual statement requests
- PIXEL user base maturing—first cohort completing full financial years
- Growth phase requires trust-building through table-stakes features before advanced differentiation

---

## 5. REGULATORY REQUIREMENTS

### Finding: No Specific Regulations Found

After thorough review of the provided RBI Master Directions and circulars, **no specific regulations were found that directly mandate annual statement formats, content requirements, or delivery timelines** for credit card issuers.

### **MANDATORY PRE-LAUNCH VERIFICATION REQUIRED:**

The following **MUST be verified** through complete RBI Master Direction - Credit Card and Debit Card – Issuance and Conduct Directions, 2022 and HDFC compliance review before launch:

| Requirement Area | Risk if Ignored | Owner |
|-----------------|------------------|-------|
| Statement content completeness (mandatory fields per RBI Master Directions) | **HIGH** — Non-compliance penalties, audit findings | Legal & Compliance |
| Data retention and access requirements | **MEDIUM** — Regulatory breach if statements unavailable for required period | Legal & Compliance |
| Password protection and data security standards | **HIGH** — Data breach liability, RBI penalties | InfoSec |
| Email delivery vs in-app delivery compliance | **LOW** — User preference, not regulatory | Legal & Compliance |

### **ADVISORY:**
- Align statement format with existing HDFC Bank credit card annual statement template to ensure consistency with proven compliant format
- Maintain audit trail of all statement generation requests (user ID, timestamp, statement period, delivery status)

---

## 6. SCOPE

### IN SCOPE:
- Annual statement generation for up to 3 financial years (FY)
- Quarterly statement generation for current and previous FY
- Asynchronous PDF generation with 30-minute SLA
- In-app view and download of generated statements
- Request mechanism through customer support agents (Phase 1)
- Self-service request mechanism in-app (Phase 2)
- Annual statement content: transaction summary, rewards summary, EMI details, add-on card information, credit limit history
- Password-protected PDF for email delivery
- Push notification on statement generation completion
- Statement request history (last 10 requests)

### OUT OF SCOPE:
- **Custom date range statements** — Adds complexity to generation logic; quarterly + annual covers 95% of tax filing use cases
- **Instant/synchronous statement generation** — Backend system requires 15-30 min compilation time for annual data; setting false expectation of instant delivery increases support load
- **CA marketplace or tax filing integrations** — Requires partnerships and legal agreements; focus on core statement access first
- **Intelligent tax categorization or spend analytics** — Requires ML model development; zero-friction access is higher priority than intelligence layer
- **Statements older than 3 financial years** — Data retention policies and diminishing user need (ITR amendments typically within 2-3 years)
- **Physical statement mailing** — Digital-first product; users can print PDF if needed

---

## 7. USER STORIES & ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA

### **User Story 1: Self-Service Annual Statement Download (Happy Path)**
**Priority:** P0  
**Actor:** Self-employed credit cardholder filing ITR

**As a** self-employed credit card user  
**I want to** request and download my annual financial statement (FY 2023-24) from the PIXEL app  
**So that** I can share it with my CA for income tax filing without calling customer care

**Acceptance Criteria:**

**Given** I am logged into the PIXEL app and have completed at least one full financial year with my card  
**When** I navigate to Statements → Annual Statements → Select "FY 2023-24" → Tap "Request Statement"  
**Then** 
- I see confirmation message: "Your statement is being generated. You'll receive a notification within 30 minutes."
- Request appears in "Statement History" with status "In Progress"
- I receive push notification within 30 minutes: "Your FY 2023-24 statement is ready"
- Statement appears in "Annual Statements" list with "View" and "Download" options
- PDF opens in-app with password prompt (password = Date of Birth in DDMMYYYY format)
- Statement includes: all billed transactions, rewards earned/redeemed, EMI details, add-on card transactions, credit limit changes

**Failure State AC:**  
**Given** statement generation fails due to backend error  
**When** 30 minutes elapse  
**Then** 
- User receives push notification: "We couldn't generate your statement. Please try again or contact support."
- Request status in "Statement History" shows "Failed" with "Retry" button
- User can retry immediately or contact support with Request ID

---

### **User Story 2: Quarterly Statement Download for Advance Tax**
**Priority:** P1  
**Actor:** Salaried professional filing advance tax

**As a** salaried professional paying advance tax  
**I want to** download quarterly statements (Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4 of FY 2024-25)  
**So that** I can calculate my advance tax liability every quarter without waiting for annual statement

**Acceptance Criteria:**

**Given** I am in the current financial year (FY 2024-25) and have completed at least one quarter  
**When** I navigate to Statements → Quarterly Statements → Select "Q1 FY 2024-25" (Apr-Jun) → Tap "Request Statement"  
**Then** 
- Same generation flow as annual statement (30-min SLA, push notification, in-app view/download)
- Statement includes only transactions billed in that quarter
- Quarterly statements available for current FY and previous FY only (max 8 quarters)

**Failure State AC:**  
**Given** I request a quarter that is not yet complete (e.g., Q2 requested on May 15)  
**When** I tap "Request Statement"  
**Then** 
- Error message: "Q2 FY 2024-25 is not yet complete. Quarterly statements are available only after the quarter ends."
- Request is not submitted

---

### **User Story 3: View Previously Generated Statement**
**Priority:** P0  
**Actor:** Any cardholder

**As a** cardholder  
**I want to** view and re-download a statement I requested 2 weeks ago  
**So that** I don't have to request it again and wait 30 minutes

**Acceptance Criteria:**

**Given** I previously requested FY 2023-24 statement 2 weeks ago  
**When** I navigate to Statements → Annual Statements  
**Then** 
- I see "FY 2023-24" with "View" and "Download" buttons (no "Request" button)
- Tapping "View" opens PDF in-app with password prompt
- Tapping "Download" saves PDF to device with filename: `PIXEL_Annual_Statement_FY2023-24_<CardLast4Digits>.pdf`
- No regeneration required; existing PDF served instantly

**Failure State AC:**  
**Given** previously generated statement is older than 90 days  
**When** I tap "View"  
**Then** 
- Message: "This statement has expired. Please request a new one."
- "Request Again" button appears

---

### **User Story 4: Customer Care Agent-Assisted Request (Phase 1 Only)**
**Priority:** P0  
**Actor:** Customer care agent

**As a** customer care agent  
**I want to** request an annual statement on behalf of a user who called in  
**So that** the user receives their statement without me explaining app navigation

**Acceptance Criteria:**

**Given** user calls and requests FY 2023-24 statement  
**When** I enter Card Number + FY selection in internal CS portal → Click "Generate Statement"  
**Then** 
- System triggers same backend flow as self-service request
- User receives push notification + email within 30 minutes
- Statement appears in user's app under "Annual Statements"
- CS portal shows Request ID and status for tracking

**Failure State AC:**  
**Given** user's card is blocked or closed  
**When** I attempt to generate statement  
**Then** 
- Error message: "Statement cannot be generated for blocked/closed cards. Escalate to L2 support."

---

### **User Story 5: Email Delivery Fallback**
**Priority:** P1  
**Actor:** Any cardholder

**As a** cardholder  
**I want to** receive the statement via email if I don't have app access  
**So that** I can still file my taxes even if my phone is unavailable

**Acceptance Criteria:**

**Given** statement generation is complete  
**When** 30 minutes elapse  
**Then** 
- User receives email to registered email ID with subject: "Your HDFC PIXEL Annual Statement (FY 2023-24)"
- Email body includes: "Your statement is attached. Password: Your Date of Birth (DDMMYYYY). You can also view it in the PIXEL app."
- PDF attached as password-protected file
- Email sent even if push notification is delivered

**Failure State AC:**  
**Given** email delivery fails (invalid email, bounce)  
**When** system detects failure  
**Then** 
- User sees in-app banner: "We couldn't email your statement. Please update your email in Profile settings."
- Statement still available for in-app view/download

## 9. ROLLOUT STRATEGY

### **Phase 1: CS-Assisted + In-App View (MVP)**
**Timeline:** Q1 2025 (Jan-Mar)  
**Rollout:** 100% of users (backend capability), 0% self-service UI  

**What Ships:**
- Backend API for statement generation (annual + quarterly)
- CS portal integration: agents can trigger statement generation
- In-app "Statements" section shows generated statements (view/download only, no self-service request)
- Email delivery with password-protected PDF
- Push notification on generation completion
- Statement request history (last 10 requests)

**Rollout %:** 100% of CS agents trained; all users can receive statements via CS call  
**Kill Switch Condition:** >10% statement generation failures OR >50% email delivery failures  
**Success Gate to Phase 2:** 
- 95%+ statement generation success rate
- <5% CS escalations due to statement issues
- Positive CS feedback on portal usability

---

### **Phase 2: Self-Service Request (V1)**
**Timeline:** Q2 2025 (Apr-Jun) — Timed for tax season  
**Rollout:** 10% → 50% → 100% over 4 weeks  

**What Ships:**
- In-app "Request Statement" button for annual + quarterly statements
- FY and quarter selection UI
- Request status tracking ("In Progress" / "Ready" / "Failed")
- Retry mechanism for failed requests
- User education: in-app tooltip + push notification announcing feature

**Rollout %:** 
- Week 1: 10% of users (random selection, exclude VIP/HNI segment to avoid risk)
- Week 2: 50% if no critical issues
- Week 4: 100%

**Kill Switch Condition:** 
- >15% of self-service requests result in CS call (indicates poor UX)
- >10% statement generation failures
- User complaints >50 in first week

**Success Gate to V2:** 
- 70%+ self-service adoption rate
- <5% retry rate
- NPS >40 for feature (in-app survey post-download)

---

### **Phase 3: Enhanced Features (V2)**
**Timeline:** Q3 2025 (Jul-Sep)  
**Rollout:** 100% of users  

**What Ships:**
- Statement preview (first page thumbnail before full download)
- Share statement directly from app (WhatsApp, email)
- Multi-year bulk download (select FY 2022-23 + FY 2023-24 → single ZIP file)
- Spend category summary in statement (if analytics backend ready)
- Reminder: "Tax season is here—download your FY 2024-25 statement" (push notification in April)
